evals.name: people-signed-incremental-employee-sync
evals.prompt: 我们用 Moka People 做人事系统。请用 Python 写一个脚本，每小时跑一次，把过去一小时内信息有更新的员工拉下来，按工号 upsert 到我们自己的 PostgreSQL。CSM 已经给了 apiKey、entCode 和签名用的 RSA 私钥，我们在 People 后台“对外接口设置”里也建好了员工任职信息的接口。
evals.expected_output: 脚本对 https://api.mokahr.com/api-platform/hcm/oapi/v1/batch/data 发 POST：Authorization 为 Basic base64(apiKey + ':')；query 带 entCode、apiCode、nonce、毫秒 timestamp、userName 和 sign，sign 为除 sign 外 query 参数按字典序拼接后的 MD5withRSA Base64 并 URL 编码；body 用 startDate/endDate（yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss）过滤更新时间，pageNum 翻页、pageSize ≤ 200；判 code 200；处理 HTTP 600 限流；每次请求重新生成 nonce 与签名。
expectations: Calls POST https://api.mokahr.com/api-platform/hcm/oapi/v1/batch/data (the People base path hcm/oapi), not an ATS /api-platform/v1 endpoint
Sends Authorization: Basic with base64 of the apiKey followed by a colon (empty password)
Puts entCode, apiCode, nonce, timestamp and sign in the query string, not in the JSON body or headers
timestamp is in milliseconds and nonce is regenerated per request (alphanumeric, at most 8-10 characters)

sign is computed over all query parameters except sign, sorted by key and joined as k=v with &, signed with RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 using MD5 (MD5withRSA), Base64-encoded, and URL-encoded exactly once when sent
Includes userName (an employee email, e.g. a super admin) in the query and includes it in the signed string
Filters by update time with body startDate and endDate in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format and paginates with pageNum plus pageSize no greater than 200
Treats code 200 as success and handles the People rate-limit response (HTTP 600 or code 600) with backoff, keeping below 60 requests per minute
Uses the uuid / employee_no fields from data.list for the upsert and does not assume pending hires (待入职) are included

evals.name: ats-incremental-applications-and-stage-move
evals.prompt: 用 Python 写一个每日任务：把 Moka 招聘里从昨天起有更新的申请（候选人投递）全部拉下来，取到候选人姓名、手机号、职位和当前阶段写进我们的 BI 库；另外对 BI 里标记为“笔试通过”的申请，在 Moka 里把它挪到该职位流程的“面试”阶段。我们有 Moka 的 API Key。
evals.expected_output: 用 GET /api-platform/v1/data/applications 首次带 fromTime、之后只带 next 直到响应没有 next；再把 id 按每批 ≤ 20 调 POST /api-platform/v3/data/getApplictaions（文档原拼写）取详情并判 code == 200；移动阶段先 GET /v1/data/job_stages?jobId= 找到“面试”阶段 id，再 PUT /v1/applications/move_application_stage?applicationId=&stageId=（参数在 query），判 code == 0；Basic 鉴权带冒号，全部 https。
expectations: Uses Basic auth with the API key as username and an empty password (requests auth=(key, '') or curl -u 'KEY:')
Pages GET /api-platform/v1/data/applications by sending fromTime only on the first request and only next afterwards, stopping when the response has no next field
[doc-vs-probe 2026-09-11] Fetches details with POST /api-platform/v3/data/getApplictaions using the doc's spelling (a probe showed the correctly spelled getApplications path returns 404)
Batches applicationIds into groups of at most 20 for the detail call and treats code == 200 as success
Reads name, phone, job title and stage from candidateBaseInfo / contactInfo / job / stage in applicationList
Resolves the target stage id from GET /api-platform/v1/data/job_stages?jobId=... (a bare JSON array) rather than hard-coding it
Moves the application with PUT /api-platform/v1/applications/move_application_stage passing applicationId and stageId as query parameters (not a JSON body) and checks code == 0
Uses https:// for every call even though some doc examples show http://
[doc-vs-probe 2026-09-11] Does not blindly retry HTTP 500 responses whose msg says 无法识别的认证信息 / 系统中不存在该apiKey (that is how ATS reports bad credentials)

evals.name: ats-pushcandidate-webhook-and-hired-writeback
evals.prompt: HR 在 Moka 招聘里对待入职候选人点“导入EHR”后，Moka 会推送候选人信息到我们的接口。帮我用 Python Flask 写这个接收接口：校验请求确实来自 Moka，把候选人建档到我们的 EHR；等候选人真正报到后，我们的系统要调用 Moka 接口把这份申请标记为已入职（试用期 3 个月，不关联招聘需求）。CSM 已经给了 webhook 的 signing key 和 API Key。
evals.expected_output: Flask 接口读取原始 body，用 signing key 对原始字节做 HMAC-SHA256 十六进制并与 URL query 的 sign 常量时间比较；解析 event == pushCandidate 与 data.applicationId 等；成功返回 2xx，失败返回非 2xx 并在 body 给出可读 msg（HR 会看到）；尽快下载会过期的 resumeUrl。入职回写调用 PUT https://api.mokahr.com/api-platform/v1/applications/{applicationId}/hired，body 含 hiredAt 与 probation=3，不传 hcId 键（不能传 null 或空串），判 success 字段；鉴权为 Basic KEY:。
expectations: Reads the signature from the sign query parameter of the webhook URL, not from an HTTP header

Computes HMAC-SHA256 with the signing key over the raw request body bytes (or an exact JSON.stringify-equivalent compact serialization with ensure_ascii=False) and compares the lowercase hex digest in constant time
[local-recompute 2026-09-11] Does not re-serialize the parsed body with Python's default json.dumps before signing (default separators and ASCII escaping change the signature)
Handles the envelope fields id, event, triggeredAt, data and branches on event == 'pushCandidate', using data.applicationId as the key
Returns a 2xx status on success and a non-2xx status with a human-readable msg on failure (the HR user sees import failures in Moka)
Downloads or persists data.resumeUrl promptly instead of storing only the URL (it is a signed, expiring link)
Marks hire with PUT https://api.mokahr.com/api-platform/v1/applications/{applicationId}/hired with hiredAt and probation = 3 in the JSON body
Omits the hcId key entirely rather than sending hcId: null or an empty string
Checks the success field (and errorMessage) of the hired response rather than a code field, and uses Basic auth with the API key followed by a colon
